_comment: Hand-curated. A rooftop is listed here ONLY when the seller itself states, on its own site, that its whole inventory carries branded titles. Quote the seller's words and where they were read; the rule in lib/branded-title-dealers.mjs applies branded_title_disclosed to every car it lists. Candidates arrive from buyback-dealers.mjs's review line; verify by reading the page before adding. An entry may also carry sellerNames: name prefixes (case-insensitive) that identify the same seller on a marketplace feed, where the row's dealerDomain is the marketplace's, not the seller's.
